Plus, Michelle McCool demands an apology and much more action.

videos.title: January 9, 2009
videos.overview: SmackDown General Manager Vickie Guerrero stacks the deck against Triple H by forcing The Game to earn his spot in the Royal Rumble by competing in a series of matches dubbed Triple Jeopardy. The Undertaker faces United States Champion Shelton Benjamin. Plus, The Brian Kendrick & Ezekiel Jackson challenge for the WWE Tag Team Championship.

videos.title: January 16, 2009
videos.overview: Triple H's hopes of competing in the 2009 Royal Rumble Match are dependent on a less than fortunate Superstar, as SmackDown General Manager Vickie Guerrero tasks MVP with representing The Game against Big Show in a Last Man Standing Match. WWE Champion Jeff Hardy feels the heat when Edge invites to him to be his guest on The Cutting Edge.

videos.title: January 23, 2009
videos.overview: Despite vehemently denying any involvement with the recent accident befalling WWE Champion Jeff Hardy, Edge finds himself competing in a No Disqualification Match against Matt Hardy. Triple H takes on Vladimir Kozlov. World Tag Team Champions The Miz and John Morrison face WWE Tag Team Champions Primo and Epico. All this and much more.

videos.title: January 30, 2009
videos.overview: Matt Hardy takes to the ring to explain why he turned on his brother. The Undertaker, Triple H, Vladimir Kozlov, and many more compete in a series of matches to qualify for the upcoming Elimination Chamber Match. Umaga goes one-on-one with Jimmy Wang Yang. Plus, tensions between Michelle McCool and Eve Torres rise and MVP takes on Chavo Guerrero.

videos.title: February 6, 2009
videos.overview: Before all four Superstars compete against each other in the upcoming Elimination Chamber Match at No Way Out, Triple H partners with The Undertaker to take on Big Show and WWE Champion Edge. SmackDown General Manager Vickie Guerrero raises the stakes for a 16-Man Battle Royal. Matt Hardy calls out Hurricane Helms. Plus, Umaga in action and more.

videos.title: February 13, 2009
videos.overview: While Edge looks to avoid injury before defending the WWE Championship inside the Elimination Chamber, four of the five challengers for his title meet in a Fatal 4-Way Match. Jeff Hardy returns to SmackDown to address his sibling rivalry with Matt Hardy. World Tag Team Champions The Miz & John Morrison face WWE Tag Team Champions Primo & Epico.

videos.title: February 20, 2009
videos.overview: After capturing the World Heavyweight Championship at No Way Out, Edge battles Jeff Hardy in the main event. SmackDown General Manager Vickie Guerrero looks to prevent any Raw Superstars from facing The Undertaker at WrestleMania XXV. Triple H addresses Randy Orton's recent assault on Mr. McMahon in a one-on-one interview with Jim Ross.

videos.title: February 27, 2009
videos.overview: Much to the dismay of SmackDown General Manager Vickie Guerrero, John Cena returns to the brand in pursuit of an opportunity to challenge Edge for the World Heavyweight Championship. Vladimir Kozlov looks to continue his undefeated streak in a one-on-one confrontation with The Undertaker. Jeff and Matt Hardy battle each other in the main event.

videos.title: March 6, 2009
videos.overview: John Cena makes his presence felt when Big Show and Edge meet to sign the contract for their battle for the World Heavyweight Championship at WrestleMania. The Undertaker accepts Shawn Michaels' challenge to face him on The Grandest Stage of Them All. Jeff Hardy takes to the ring to qualify for the upcoming Money in the Bank Ladder Match.

videos.title: March 13, 2009
videos.overview: The Undertaker battles Vladimir Kozlov. World Heavyweight Champion Edge goes one-on-one with Kofi Kingston. The Miz & John Morrison defend the World Tag Team Championship against WWE Tag Team Champions Primo & Epico. Plus, R-Truth, Finlay, Women's Champion Melina, and many more in action.

videos.title: March 20, 2009
videos.overview: The love triangle between Big Show, Vickie Guerrero, and World Heavyweight Champion Edge continues. MVP challenges Shelton Benjamin for the United States Championship. Plus, The Undertaker faces John "Bradshaw" Layfield in the main event, WWE Champion Triple H takes on Vladimir Kozlov, and much more on this special 500th episode of SmackDown.

videos.title: March 27, 2009
videos.overview: As WrestleMania XXV rapidly approaches, Big Show finds himself getting off on the wrong foot with John Cena. On a night where Rey Mysterio meets Chavo Guerrero in singles action, John "Bradshaw" Layfield targets The Ultimate Underdog. Plus, an Eight-Man Tag Team Match, R-Truth faces Matt Hardy, and much more.

videos.title: April 3, 2009
videos.overview: In the main event, Jeff Hardy goes one-on-one with Ezekiel Jackson. MVP puts the United States Championship on the line in a match against the former champion, Shelton Benjamin. Plus, a sneak peek at all the happenings at WrestleMania Axxess, Michelle McCool & Divas Champion Maryse take on Gail Kim & Maria, and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Apr. 10, 2009
videos.overview: Jeff and Matt Hardy meet in a Stretcher Match. After losing the World Heavyweight Championship to John Cena, Edge comes face-to-face with the new champion on The Cutting Edge. Randy Orton and his Legacy take to the ring to address the golden stakes in their upcoming Six-Man Tag Team Match at Backlash. All this and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Apr. 17, 2009
videos.overview: WWE Champion Triple H has a face-to-face confrontation with Randy Orton. The ongoing problems between Matt and Jeff Hardy lead SmackDown General Manger Theodore Long to schedule them in an "I Quit" Match at Backlash. Dolph Ziggler goes one-on-one with United States Champion MVP. Plus, Batista takes on Ted DiBiase and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Apr. 24, 2009
videos.overview: Edge addresses his final opportunity at championship glory. Batista partners with Shane McMahon to take on Legacy's Cody Rhodes & Ted DiBiase. Plus, The Undertaker meets Big Show in singles action, Jeff Hardy unites with CM Punk to battle Kane & Matt Hardy, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - May. 01, 2009
videos.overview: World Heavyweight Champion Edge goes one-on-one with Mr. Money in the Bank CM Punk in the main event. The No. 1 Contender for World Heavyweight Championship is decided in a Fatal 4-Way Match between Chris Jericho, Kane, Jeff Hardy, and Intercontinental Champion Rey Mysterio. MVP defends the United States Championship against Dolph Ziggler.

videos.title: SmackDown - May. 08, 2009
videos.overview: In an attempt to silence Chris Jericho's constant complaining, Jeff Hardy makes Y2J an offer he can't refuse. Intercontinental Champion Rey Mysterio addresses the WWE Universe. World Heavyweight Champion Edge and CM Punk clash in singles action. Plus, Layla meets Eve Torres in an Arm Wrestling Match, Dolph Ziggler faces The Great Khali, and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - May. 15, 2009
videos.overview: Chris Jericho goes one-on-one with World Heavyweight Champion Edge. CM Punk partners with John Morrison to take on The World's Greatest Tag Team of Charlie Haas & Shelton Benjamin. Plus, Jeff Hardy prepares for his golden opportunity by competing in singles action, R-Truth faces off against Mike Knox, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - May. 22, 2009
videos.overview: Jeff Hardy and World Heavyweight Champion Edge battle each other for the right to choose the stipulation for their upcoming match at Extreme Rules. CM Punk goes one-on-one with Chris Jericho. Plus, Michelle McCool faces Gail Kim for an opportunity at the Women's Championship, R-Truth takes on Dolph Ziggler, and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - May. 29, 2009
videos.overview: Intercontinental Champion Rey Mysterio & Jeff Hardy take on Chris Jericho & World Heavyweight Champion Edge. CM Punk looks to even the score with Umaga when The Samoan Bulldozer takes to the ring to go one-on-one with John Morrison. Plus, Women's Champion Melina faces off against Alicia Fox in a Non-Title Match, R-Truth in action, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jun. 05, 2009
videos.overview: World Heavyweight Champion Edge welcomes Jeff Hardy to The Cutting Edge to discuss their upcoming Ladder Match at Extreme Rules. The Rated-R Superstar also faces Intercontinental Champion Rey Mysterio in a Champion vs. Champion Match. Just days before they meet in a Samoan Strap Match, CM Punk and Umaga collide in singles competition.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jun. 12, 2009
videos.overview: Edge and Jeff Hardy clash to determine the No. 1 Contender for the World Heavyweight Championship. CM Punk goes one-on-one with Intercontinental Champion Chris Jericho. John Morrison unites with R-Truth to take on The World's Greatest Tag Team of Charlie Haas & Shelton Benjamin. All this and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jun. 19, 2009
videos.overview: Jeff Hardy faces Intercontinental Champion Chris Jericho. World Heavyweight Champion CM Punk battles Rey Mysterio. Edge faces off against John Morrison. R-Truth partners with Cryme Tyme to battle Ricky Ortiz & The World's Greatest Tag Team of Charlie Haas & Shelton Benjamin in a Six-Man Tag Team Match. All this and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jun. 26, 2009
videos.overview: Fresh off buying Raw back from Donald Trump, Mr. McMahon returns to SmackDown to put Theodore Long in his place. However, the SmackDown General Manager looks to impress The Chairman by having Jeff Hardy & Rey Mysterio face Edge & Intercontinental Champion Chris Jericho inside a steel cage. World Heavyweight Champion CM Punk battles John Morrison.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jul. 03, 2009
videos.overview: World Heavyweight Champion CM Punk & Jeff Hardy face Unified WWE Tag Team Champions Edge & Chris Jericho in a tag team match main event. Intercontinental Champion Rey Mysterio takes to the ring to go one-on-one with Kane. Plus, SmackDown General Manager Teddy Long remains on probation, Dolph Ziggler in action, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jul. 10, 2009
videos.overview: Chris Jericho challenges Intercontinental Champion Rey Mysterio for the gold. After World Heavyweight Champion CM Punk makes his presence felt during a bout between Kane and Jeff Hardy, The Big Red Machine returns the favor when The Straight Edge Superstar goes one-on-one with The Great Khali. Plus, Cryme Tyme battles The Hart Dynasty and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jul. 17, 2009
videos.overview: Jeff Hardy & Intercontinental Champion Rey Mysterio face Dolph Ziggler & Chris Jericho in the main event. While CM Punk goes one-on-one with John Morrison. All this and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jul. 24, 2009
videos.overview: While continuing to spread his gospel of living a straight edge lifestyle to the WWE Universe, World Heavyweight Champion CM Punk takes to the ring to go one-on-one with Intercontinental Champion Rey Mysterio in the main event. Chris Jericho faces off against Jeff Hardy. The Great Khali sets his sights on making short work out of Mike Knox.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jul. 31, 2009
videos.overview: Just days after successfully defeating CM Punk to reclaim the World Heavyweight Championship at Night of Champions, Jeff Hardy puts the gold on the line in the main event when he goes one-on-one with John Morrison. In a battle to determine the new No. 1 Contenders for the Unified WWE Tag Team Championships Cryme Tyme takes on The Hart Dynasty.

videos.title: SmackDown - Aug. 07, 2009
videos.overview: CM Punk challenges Jeff Hardy for the World Heavyweight Championship in the main event. Finlay, Mike Knox, R-Truth, and Dolph Ziggler compete against each other in a Fatal 4-Way Match for an opportunity to challenge Rey Mysterio for the Intercontinental Championship. With Big Show in his corner, Chris Jericho faces off against JTG.

videos.title: SmackDown - Aug. 14, 2009
videos.overview: Jeff Hardy is forced into taking on The Hart Dynasty in a Handicap Match main event. While The Charismatic Enigma prepares to pull double duty, CM Punk takes to the ring to go one-on-one with John Morrison. Plus, Finlay and Dolph Ziggler clash in singles competition, Big Show faces off with Cryme Tyme's JTG, and much more action.

videos.title: SmackDown - Aug. 21, 2009
videos.overview: World Heavyweight Champion Jeff Hardy continues his efforts to silence CM Punk's rhetoric by partnering with Matt Hardy and John Morrison to take on The Straight Edge Superstar and The Hart Dynasty's Tyson Kidd and David Hart Smith in a huge Six-Man Tag Team Match main event. Plus, Dolph Ziggler, Intercontinental Champion Rey Mysterio, and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Aug. 28, 2009
videos.overview: The heated rivalry between Jeff Hardy and CM Punk comes to an end when The Straight Edge Superstar defends the World Heavyweight Championship against The Charismatic Enigma in a Loser Leaves WWE Steel Cage Match main event. Plus, John Morrison partners with Matt Hardy to take on The Hart Dynasty, Drew McIntyre makes his in-ring debut, and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Sep. 04, 2009
videos.overview: World Heavyweight Champion CM Punk finds his high moral ground eclipsed by the darkness of The Undertaker's return. Rey Mysterio puts the Intercontinental Championship on the line against John Morrison. Finlay partners with The Great Khali to take on Mike Knox & Kane. Drew McIntyre makes a statement at R-Truth's expense. All this and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Sep. 11, 2009
videos.overview: CM Punk faces Matt Hardy in a Submission Match. Following his recent capture of the Intercontinental Championship, John Morrison takes to the ring to go one-on-one with Charlie Haas. Plus, Finlay faces off against Mike Knox in a Belfast Brawl, Cryme Tyme takes on Unified WWE Tag Team Champions Jeri-Show, and much more action.

videos.title: SmackDown - Sep. 18, 2009
videos.overview: The sins of SmackDown General Manager Teddy Long earn him a chauffeured journey on the Highway to Hell courtesy of The Undertaker. Batista goes one-on-one with Chris Jericho in the main event. Plus, Dolph Ziggler gets a front row seat when Intercontinental Champion John Morrison battles Mike Knox, Kane looks to dismantle The Great Khali, and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Sep. 25, 2009
videos.overview: Following The Undertaker's recent abduction of SmackDown General Manager Theodore Long, The Deadman is granted a World Heavyweight Championship opportunity against CM Punk at Hell in a Cell and a match against The Straight Edge Superstar in the main event of this edition of SmackDown. Plus, Big Show goes one-on-one with Batista, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Oct. 02, 2009
videos.overview: Superstars from both ECW and Raw come to SmackDown for the brand's 10th anniversary. D-Generation X partners with The Undertaker & WWE Champion John Cena to take on World Heavyweight Champion CM Punk and all three members of Legacy. Plus, Batista and Kane meet, Michelle McCool defends the Women's Championship against Melina, and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Oct. 09, 2009
videos.overview: With the World Heavyweight Championship around the waist of The Undertaker once again, Mr. McMahon announces that The Deadman will defend his title against three Superstars at Bragging Rights. John Morrison defends the Intercontinental Championship against Dolph Ziggler. Chris Jericho faces Rey Mysterio. Plus, Drew McIntyre in action and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Oct. 16, 2009
videos.overview: On a night where Chris Jericho is chosen by SmackDown General Manager Theodore Long to lead the brand into battle against Raw at Bragging Rights, several Superstars compete for the chance to fight alongside Y2J. Rey Mysterio faces off against Batista in the main event. All this and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Oct. 23, 2009
videos.overview: Kane & Chris Jericho take on Rey Mysterio & Batista. Just days before defending the World Heavyweight Championship in a Fatal 4-Way Match, The Undertaker puts the gold on the line against CM Punk in a Submission Match main event. Intercontinental Champion John Morrison takes to the ring to go one-on-one with Mike Knox. All this and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Oct. 30, 2009
videos.overview: With Big Show's betrayal of Team Raw at Bragging Rights earning him a World Heavyweight Championship opportunity at Survivor Series, Kane and Chris Jericho collide in the main event to determine which Superstar will be added to the battle for the gold. Mr. McMahon gives CM Punk an opportunity to punish referee Scott Armstrong. All this and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Nov. 06, 2009
videos.overview: Tensions on the road to Survivor Series continue to rise when World Heavyweight Champion The Undertaker chastises Big Show and Chris Jericho for their recent actions. Batista's change in attitude is exemplified when The Animal goes one-on-one with Matt Hardy in the main event. Plus, Rey Mysterio, CM Punk, and many more in action!.

videos.title: SmackDown - Nov. 13, 2009
videos.overview: The Undertaker and Chris Jericho meet each other in singles action for the first time ever. Rey Mysterio and Batista sign the contract for their upcoming battle at Survivor Series. Plus, Dolph Ziggler challenges John Morrison for the Intercontinental Championship, CM Punk goes one-on-one with R-Truth, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Nov. 20, 2009
videos.overview: The Brothers of Destruction take on the Unified WWE Tag Team Champions Jeri-Show. Dolph Ziggler receives another chance at the Intercontinental Championship in a 2-Out-of-3 Falls Match against John Morrison. After CM Punk uses SmackDown as a forum to preach his gospel of straight edge, R-Truth seizes an opportunity to interrupt his sermon.

videos.title: SmackDown - Nov. 27, 2009
videos.overview: World Heavyweight Champion The Undertaker faces Chris Jericho. Kane and Batista battle to determine the No. 1 Contender for Undertaker's title. CM Punk introduces the WWE Universe to his newest disciple. John Morrison defends the Intercontinental Championship against Vickie Guerrero's boyfriend Eric Escobar. All this and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Dec. 04, 2009
videos.overview: Batista makes a statement. Beth Phoenix, Mickie James, and Natalya compete in a Triple Threat Match to determine the No. 1 Contender for the Women's Championship. Plus, Luke Gallows proves to be a dangerous asset in CM Punk's straight edge crusade, Drew McIntyre goes one-on-one with Intercontinental Champion John Morrison, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Dec. 11, 2009
videos.overview: Batista battles Rey Mysterio in a Street Fight. The foundations of a Straight Edge Society continue to spread throughout the WWE Universe when CM Punk & Luke Gallows battle Matt Hardy & R- Truth. Plus, the rivalry between Drew McIntyre and Intercontinental Champion John Morrison escalates, Kane goes one-on-one with Mike Knox, and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Dec. 18, 2009
videos.overview: Batista battles Rey Mysterio to determine a new No. 1 Contender for the World Heavyweight Championship. Intercontinental Champion Drew McIntyre partners with CM Punk & Luke Gallows to take on John Morrison, Matt Hardy & R-Truth. Plus, Chris Jericho meets The Great Khali in singles action, Kane faces Eric Escobar, and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Dec. 25, 2009
videos.overview: D-Generation X invades this special Christmas edition of SmackDown to defend the Unified WWE Tag Team Championships against The Hart Dynasty in the main event. Rey Mysterio looks to once again claim gold when he challenges The Undertaker for the World Heavyweight Championship. All this and much more!

videos.title: SmackDown - Jan. 01, 2010
videos.overview: Several Superstars compete in a series of Beat the Clock Challenges to determine the new No. 1 Contender for the World Heavyweight Championship. Drew McIntyre puts the Intercontinental Championship on the line in memorable confrontation with John Morrison. Plus, Beth Phoenix, Matt Hardy, and many more in action.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jan. 08, 2010
videos.overview: Rey Mysterio battles Batista in the main event to see who will face World Heavyweight Champion The Undertaker at the Royal Rumble. CM Punk's self-righteous crusade throughout WWE continues as he looks to add another lost soul to his Straight Edge Society. R-Truth partners with Cryme Tyme to take on The Hart Dynasty. All this and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jan. 15, 2010
videos.overview: After The Undertaker's interference cost both men a chance to become the new No. 1 Contender for the World Heavyweight Championship, Batista and Rey Mysterio meet in a Steel Cage Match main event to finally determine who will challenge The Deadman for his title at the Royal Rumble. Chris Jericho faces John Morrison and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jan. 22, 2010
videos.overview: When Rey Mysterio calls out The Undertaker before they meet for the World Heavyweight Championship at the Royal Rumble, The Ultimate Underdog finds him face-to-face with a different kind of animal. CM Punk's Straight Edge Society continues to grow after a unknown woman pledges her allegiance to his teachings and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jan. 29, 2010
videos.overview: Triple H goes one-on-one with CM Punk as Shawn Michaels faces Rey Mysterio in the main event. In a No Disqualification Match, John Morrison once again challenges Drew McIntyre for the Intercontinental Championship. Plus, Chris Jericho collides with R-Truth, Women's Champion Michelle McCool continues to taunt Mikie James, and much more action.

videos.title: SmackDown - Feb. 05, 2010
videos.overview: Edge addresses his opportunity at WrestleMania XXVI on The Cutting Edge. Rey Mysterio, John Morrison, Chris Jericho and many more Superstars compete in a series of matches in the hopes of qualifying for the Elimination Chamber. Just days after capturing the Women's Championship, Mickie James teams with Beth Phoenix to take on LayCool.

videos.title: SmackDown - Feb. 12, 2010
videos.overview: Chris Jericho goes one-on-one with World Heavyweight Champion The Undertaker in a No Disqualification Match. With his Straight Edge Society in his corner, CM Punk takes to the ring to face off against Rey Mysterio. Plus, Women's Champion Mickie James meets both members of LayCool in a 2-on-1 Handicap Match and John Morrison takes on R-Truth.

videos.title: SmackDown - Feb. 19, 2010
videos.overview: Edge tries to avoid the Undertaker's wrath during a main event match against Batista. CM Punk makes in intentions for Elimination Chamber known and joins with his Straight Edge Society disciple Luke Gallows to take on John Morrison & R- Truth. Matt Hardy & The Great Khali team with Maria Kanellis in a Mixed Tag Team Match against The Hart Dynasty.

videos.title: SmackDown - Feb. 26, 2010
videos.overview: Edge and United States Champion The Miz tangle in the main event. Drew McIntyre, Dolph Ziggler, R-Truth, John Morrison, Kane, CM Punk, and Shelton Benjamin all compete in Money in the Bank Qualifying Matches. Women's Champion Mickie James defends her title against Michelle McCool with special guest referee Vickie Guerrero.

videos.title: SmackDown - Mar. 05, 2010
videos.overview: John Morrison & R-Truth battle The Hart Dynasty and Cryme Tyme in a Triple Threat Tag Team Match for a chance at challenging ShoMiz for the Unified WWE Tag Team Titles at WrestleMania. Big Show goes one-on-one with Edge. Matt Hardy and Intercontinental Champion Drew McIntyre look to qualify for the Money in the Bank Ladder Match. All this and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Mar. 12, 2010
videos.overview: World Heavyweight Champion Chris Jericho invites Edge to The Highlight Reel. When Rey Mysterio looks to celebrate his daughter's birthday with the WWE Universe, CM Punk and his Straight Edge Society crash the festivities. John Morrison battles Big Show. Plus, Drew Mcintyre proves he is a fighting champion, Undertaker makes a statement, and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Mar. 19, 2010
videos.overview: Edge hosts The Cutting Edge, featuring World Heavyweight Champion Chris Jericho and his NXT pupil Wade Barrett. When an angry Rey Mysterio decides to accept CM Punk's recent challenge to face him on The Grandest Stage of Them All, the self-proclaimed Straight Edge Savior ups the ante. All this and much more!

videos.title: SmackDown - Mar. 26, 2010
videos.overview: Just days before teaming with John Morrison to challenge ShoMiz for the Unified WWE Tag Team Titles, R-Truth takes to the ring to go one-on-one with Big Show in the main event. All the competitors in the Money in the Bank Ladder Match meet in a 10-Man Tag Team Match. Plus, preview the matches coming at WrestleMania. All this and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Apr. 02, 2010
videos.overview: Despite successfully retaining the World Heavyweight Championship against Edge at WrestleMania XXVI, Chris Jericho finds the celebration cut short when Jack Swagger seizes an opportunity to turn his newly won Money in the Bank contract into gold. Plus, the NXT Rookies are given one hell of a challenge, Dolph Ziggler in action, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Apr. 09, 2010
videos.overview: With an opportunity to challenge Jack Swagger for the World Heavyweight Championship at Extreme Rules at stake, Chris Jericho and Edge clash. Jack Swagger goes one-on-one with John Morrison. Plus, Rey Mysterio accepts CM Punk's recent challenge, Shad Gaspard explains his motivations for turning on JTG, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Apr. 16, 2010
videos.overview: In response to Raw Superstar Randy Orton receiving an opportunity for the World Heavyweight Championship over a competitor from SmackDown, General Manager Theodore Long orders Jack Swagger to defend the title against Chris Jericho and Edge in a Triple Threat Match main event. Plus, Kane, Dolph Ziggler, and many more in action.

videos.title: SmackDown - Apr. 23, 2010
videos.overview: Rey Mysterio & Kane take on The Straight Edge Society's CM Punk & Luke Gallows. World Heavyweight Champion Jack Swagger takes to the ring for a Non-Title Match against John Morrison. Chris Jericho vows to end Edge's career. Plus, JTG in action, LayCool faces the duo of Beth Phoenix & Mickie James, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Apr. 30, 2010
videos.overview: Edge delives a farewell address to SmackDown before heading to Raw. After treating the WWE Universe to a rendition of his life story, World Heavyweight Champion Jack Swagger finds himself standing face-to-face with a giant. The Straight Edge Society's CM Punk & Luke Gallows take on MVP & Rey Mysterio. All this and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - May. 07, 2010
videos.overview: When Drew McIntyre's actions lead SmackDown General Manager Theodore Long to strip him of the Intercontinental Championship and fire him from the brand, Superstars are given a chance to claim the vacant title in a tournament for the gold. Jack Swagger competes in a Non-Title Match against Kane. Rey Mysterio issues another challenge to CM Punk.

videos.title: SmackDown - May. 14, 2010
videos.overview: CM Punk orders his Straight Edge Society not to join him at ringside during his match against Rey Mysterio. A new Intercontinental Champion is crowned when Kofi Kingston and Christian battle for the vacant title. Big Show steps on the accomplishments of World Heavyweight Champion Jack Swagger. Beth Phoenix defends the Women's Championship.

videos.title: SmackDown - May. 21, 2010
videos.overview: With SmackDown General Manager Theodore Long's recent decisions against him being overturned, Intercontinental Champion Drew McIntyre returns to action to go one-on-one with Big Show in the main event. Christian becomes the recipient of a premeditated attack on The Peep Show. World Heavyweight Champion Jack Swagger faces Kofi Kingston.

videos.title: SmackDown - May. 28, 2010
videos.overview: Several Superstars compete in a series of matches to qualify for the upcoming Fatal 4-Way Match for the World Heavyweight Championship. Drew McIntyre partners with World Heavyweight Champion Jack Swagger to take on Intercontinental Champion Kofi Kingston & Big Show and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jun. 04, 2010
videos.overview: After the news breaks that The Undertaker was found in a vegetative state following a suspicious attack, Kane looks to lay the memory of his brother to rest. With The Deadman gone, SmackDown Superstars take to the ring to compete in a Battle Royal to take his spot in the upcoming Fatal 4-Way Match for the World Heavyweight Championship.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jun. 11, 2010
videos.overview: Big Show battles CM Punk. An altercation between Rey Mysterio and World Heavyweight Champion Jack Swagger leads to a Non-Title Match. With The Undertaker's apparent demise weighing on his mind, Kane looks to exact revenge on those responsible for harming his brother. Plus, Drew McIntyre earns a new enemy, Christian faces Dolph Ziggler, and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jun. 18, 2010
videos.overview: Jack Swagger partners with CM Punk to take on Rey Mysterio & Big Show in the main event. Kane takes exception to an impersonation of his brother The Undertaker. With his job as SmackDown General Manager on the line, Theodore Long is forced to face Drew McIntyre in singles action. All this and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jun. 25, 2010
videos.overview: SmackDown General Manager Theodore Long and Vickie Guerrero begin evaluating potential competitors for the Money in the Bank Ladder Match. CM Punk is punished by Kane in a No Disqualification Match. Drew Mcintyre finds himself facing an old nemesis. Plus, Dolph Ziggler chooses gold over romance, Jack Swagger battles Big Show, and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jul. 02, 2010
videos.overview: Jack Swagger's frustrations over losing the World Heavyweight Title get the better of him when he partners with "Dashing" Cody Rhodes against Big Show & World Heavyweight Champion Rey Mysterio. After going one-on-one with Luke Gallows, Kane learns that his quest for vengeance against The Straight Edge Society may be unjustified.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jul. 09, 2010
videos.overview: Big Show faces Jack Swagger in the main event. After being humbled by SmackDown General Manager Theodore Long, Drew McIntyre sets out to qualify for the Money in the Bank Ladder Match by facing Intercontinental Champion Kofi Kingston. CM Punk judges whether or not Serena should be excommunicated from his Straight Edge Society. All this and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jul. 16, 2010
videos.overview: Jack Swagger looks to prove his innocence in The Undertaker's demise as he battles Kane in the main event. The Straight Edge Society fails to prevent Big Show from exacting revenge on their leader, CM Punk. Plus, Christian in action, Intercontinental Champion Kofi Kingston goes one-on-one with Cody Rhodes, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jul. 23, 2010
videos.overview: Rey Mysterio battles Jack Swagger in a 2-Out-of-3 Falls Match. Christian partners with Matt Hardy to take on Drew McIntyre & Cody Rhodes. Plus, Big Show's problems with CM Punk and his Straight Edge Society continue, Dolph Ziggler faces off against Intercontinental Champion Kofi Kingston, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jul. 30, 2010
videos.overview: Rey Mysterio battles Jack Swagger in a No Disqualification Match main event. Michelle McCool defends the Women's Championship against Tiffany. In a Non-Title Match, Dolph Ziggler goes one-on-one with Intercontinental Champion Kofi Kingston. Big Show's rivalry with CM Punk and The Straight Edge Society continues when he takes on Luke Gallows.

videos.title: SmackDown - Aug. 06, 2010
videos.overview: The person responsible for The Undertaker's demise is revealed when Rey Mysterio goes one-on-one with Drew Mcintyre in the main event. MVP partners with JTG & Chris Masters to take on The Straight Edge Society's Luke Gallows, Joey Mercury & CM Punk. Dolph Ziggler challenges Kofi Kingston for the Intercontinental Championship. All this and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Aug. 13, 2010
videos.overview: World Heavyweight Champion Kane takes to the ring to go one-on-one with Kofi Kingston. Rey Mysterio gears up to take on Intercontinental Champion Dolph Ziggler in the main event. In the midst of his rivalry with CM Punk's Straight Edge Society, Big Show competes in a 3-on-1 Handicap Match. Plus, Christian, Drew McIntyre, and many more in action.

videos.title: SmackDown - Aug. 20, 2010
videos.overview: World Heavyweight Champion Kane reveals his twisted motivations for putting The Undertaker in a vegetative state. Alberto Del Rio makes his debut against Rey Mysterio in the main event. Dolph Ziggler puts the Intercontinental Championship on the line in a match against Kofi Kingston. Plus, The Straight Edge Society, Christian, and more in action.

videos.title: SmackDown - Aug. 27, 2010
videos.overview: World Heavyweight Champion Kane goes one-on-one with Rey Mysterio in a No Disqualification Match. The Undertaker addresses the sins of his brother. Big Show takes to the ring to battle Luke Gallows of The Straight Edge Society in the main event. Plus, CM Punk, Alberto Del Rio, and many more in action.

videos.title: SmackDown - Sep. 03, 2010
videos.overview: The dark and twisted sibling rivalry between The Undertaker and World Heavyweight Champion Kane is on display when The Devil's Favorite Demon sends a grave message to his brother. The Straight Edge Society's CM Punk & Luke Gallows take on Big Show in a Handicap Match. Christian takes to the ring to go one-on-one with Drew McIntyre.

videos.title: SmackDown - Sep. 10, 2010
videos.overview: The Undertaker battles CM Punk in the main event. Matt Hardy sets his sights on making a huge statement when he goes one-on-one with Alberto Del Rio. Kofi Kingston partners with The Masterpiece Chris Masters to take on Chavo Guerrero & Intercontinental Champion Dolph Ziggler. Plus, Jack Swagger, Drew McIntyre, and more in action.

videos.title: SmackDown - Sep. 17, 2010
videos.overview: The Undertaker and World Heavyweight Champion Kane meet face-to-face one last time. After trying to incite an altercation with Alberto Del Rio on The Peep Show, Christian goes one-on-one with CM Punk in the main event. Plus, Hornswoggle receives a lesson in verbal communication, Kofi Kingston takes on Jack Swagger, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Sep. 24, 2010
videos.overview: World Heavyweight Champion Kane learns that his ongoing rivalry with The Undertaker is far from over. Alberto Del Rio looks to give Christian a break. "Dashing" Cody Rhodes & Drew McIntyre defend the WWE Tag Team Championship against The Hart Dynasty. The Straight Edge Society continues to fall apart when CM Punk goes one-on-one with Luke Gallows.

videos.title: SmackDown - Oct. 01, 2010
videos.overview: Big Show battles The Nexus in a Handicap Match. John Cena faces off against World Heavyweight Champion Kane in a Lumberjack Match. The Undertaker takes to the ring to battle CM Punk. Plus, MVP challenges Dolph Ziggler for the Intercontinental Championship, the rivalry between Alberto Del Rio and Rey Mysterio rages on, and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Oct. 08, 2010
videos.overview: Following Paul Bearer's recent return from the dark side to help World Heavyweight Champion Kane get the better of The Undertaker, The Devil's Favorite Demon addresses his unholy reunion with his father. In the main event, Alberto Del Rio goes one-on-one with Rey Mysterio. Dolph Ziggler defends the Intercontinental Championship against MVP.

videos.title: SmackDown - Oct. 15, 2010
videos.overview: With the grave being the only logical place for the The Undertaker and Kane's sibling rivalry to finally come to an end, Paul Bearer beckons The Phenom to challenge The Devil's Favorite Demon for the World Heavyweight Championship in a Buried Alive Match at Bragging Rights. Plus, Superstars compete to join Team SmackDown and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Oct. 22, 2010
videos.overview: As Bragging Rights approaches, Superstars from Raw clash with the Superstars of SmackDown a little bit early. Team SmackDown's Big Show, Rey Mysterio & Kofi Kingston take on Team Raw's Sheamus, Ezekiel Jackson & The Miz. WWE Champion Randy Orton faces off against World Heavyweight Champion Kane. All this and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Oct. 29, 2010
videos.overview: Alberto Del Rio, Edge, and Rey Mysterio clash in a Triple Threat Match main event to determine the new No. 1 Contender for the World Heavyweight Championship. Two champions clash as United States Champion Daniel Bryan takes on Intercontinental Champion Dolph Ziggler. Plus, Jack Swagger, Big Show, and many more in action.

videos.title: SmackDown - Nov. 05, 2010
videos.overview: When The Nexus returns to SmackDown, SmackDown General Manager Theodore Long tasks Edge, Kofi Kingston, Big Show, Alberto Del Rio, and World Heavyweight Champion Kane to face them in a 10-Man Tag Team Match. MVP, Cody Rhodes, and Drew McIntyre clash in a Triple Threat Match to determine the No. 1 Contender for the Intercontinental Championship.

videos.title: SmackDown - Nov. 12, 2010
videos.overview: With his membership in The Nexus at stake, David Otunga looks to break his recent losing streak by returning to SmackDown to go one-on-one with Edge in a Lumberjack Match. Dolph Ziggler puts the Intercontinental Championship on the line in a match against MVP. Plus, World Heavyweight Champion Kane battles Big Show and much more action.

videos.title: SmackDown - Nov. 19, 2010
videos.overview: After kidnapping Paul Bearer on the previous edition of SmackDown, Edge uses his hostage to get the better of World Heavyweight Champion Kane. As the road to Survivor Series winds down, an altercation between the teams of Alberto Del Rio and Rey Mysterio leads SmackDown General Manager Theodore Long to make a special main event. All this and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Nov. 26, 2010
videos.overview: While Edge continues to hold Paul Bearer hostage, World Heavyweight Champion Kane is forced to give The Rated-R Superstar exactly what he wants in the hopes of getting his father back in time for the holidays. Several Superstars try to qualify for the King of the Ring Tournament. Michelle McCool goes one-on-one with Kelly Kelly. All this and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Dec. 03, 2010
videos.overview: After recently giving in to Edge's mind games to grant him a chance at the World Heavyweight Championship, Kane goes one-on-one with The Rated-R Superstar for the right to choose the stipulation for their upcoming battle. Plus, Kofi Kingston and Jack Swagger meet for a chance at the Intercontinental Championship and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Dec. 10, 2010
videos.overview: As his attempts to rescue Paul Bearer from the clutches of Edge become even more desperate, World Heavyweight Champion Kane & Alberto Del Rio take on The Rated-R Superstar & Rey Mysterio. Dolph Ziggler defends the Intercontinental Championship against Kofi Kingston. Santino Marella & Vladimir Kozlov defend the WWE Tag Team Championship.

videos.title: SmackDown - Dec. 17, 2010
videos.overview: A Tag Team Match main event is created after things break down in a battle between Rey Mysterio and WWE Champion The Miz. LayCool takes to the ring to protest their Tables Match against Natalya & Beth Phoenix. Plus, Cody Rhodes, Intercontinental Champion Dolph Ziggler, and many more in action.

videos.title: SmackDown - Dec. 21, 2010
videos.overview: On a special Christmas Eve edition of SmackDown, John Cena battles Vickie Guerrero and Intercontinental Champion Dolph Ziggler in a Handicap Match. WWE Champion The Miz faces Randy Orton in a Non-Title Match. Plus, Alberto Del Rio & Jack Swagger take on Rey Mysterio & Kofi Kingston, Big Show impersonates a holiday icon, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Dec. 31, 2010
videos.overview: Dolph Ziggler defends the Intercontinental Championship in a Triple Threat Match against Kofi Kingston and Jack Swagger. World Heavyweight Champion Edge & Rey Mysterio face Kane & Alberto Del Rio. Plus, Big Show clashes with Cody Rhodes in singles action, Beth Phoenix and Women's Champion Natalya face LayCool, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jan. 07, 2011
videos.overview: Edge defends the World Heavyweight Championship against Kane in a Last Man Standing Match. Rey Mysterio and Alberto Del Rio battle in a 2-Out-of-3 Falls Match. Dolph Ziggler defends the Intercontinental Championship against Kofi Kingston. Plus, a Triple Threat Match to determine the No. 1 Contender for the World Heavyweight Championship.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jan. 14, 2011
videos.overview: Edge welcomes Dolph Ziggler and Vickie Guerrero to The Cutting Edge. Kofi Kingston faces Jack Swagger. A verbal confrontation leads to Rey Mysterio and R-Truth battling Alberto Del Rio & Cody Rhodes. With his Nexus being taken over by CM Punk, Wade Barrett forms a new group with some familiar faces. All this and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jan. 21, 2011
videos.overview: The Corre officially introduces themselves to the WWE Universe. SmackDown General Manager Theodore Long suffers a mysterious injury. With Long out of commission, Vickie Guerrero takes control and orders one member of Wade Barrett's new army to take on World Heavyweight Champion Edge in the main event. Plus, Kofi Kingston and more in action.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jan. 28, 2011
videos.overview: Randy Orton & World Heavyweight Champion Edge face Dolph Ziggler & WWE Champion The Miz. Big Show's issues with The Corre escalate when The World's Largest Athlete goes one-on-one with Heath Slater. After a Royal Rumble Exhibition Match goes awry, Rey Mysterio partners with Kofi Kingston to take on Alberto Del Rio & Kane.

videos.title: SmackDown - Feb. 04, 2011
videos.overview: Acting SmackDown General Manager Vickie Guerrero forces Edge to defend the World Heavyweight Championship against Dolph Ziggler. Rey Mysterio, Wade Barrett, Kane, and many more SmackDown Superstars compete in a series of matches to qualify for a spot in the Elimination Chamber. Alberto Del Rio celebrates his victory in the 2011 Royal Rumble Match.

videos.title: SmackDown - Feb. 11, 2011
videos.overview: With Vickie Guerrero serving as Special Guest Referee, Dolph Ziggler challenges Edge for the World Heavyweight Championship. Alberto Del Rio and Kofi Kingston clash in singles competition. The Corre's Wade Barrett takes to the ring to go one-on-one with Rey Mysterio. Plus, Drew McIntyre in action, Layla takes on Divas Champion Eve, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Feb. 18, 2011
videos.overview: As SmackDown reaches a record-breaking milestone with 600 episodes, Superstars from both SmackDown and Raw compete in a 12-Man Tag Team Match. When Vickie Guerrero strips Edge of the World Heavyweight Championship to award the title to Dolph Ziggler, SmackDown General Manager Theodore Long returns to put a wrench in her plans. All this and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Feb. 25, 2011
videos.overview: On the orders of SmackDown General Manager Theodore Long, Vickie Guerrero's career on SmackDown is on the line in the main event when Vickie partners with Drew McIntyre for a Mixed Tag Team Match against Kelly Kelly & World Heavyweight Champion Edge. Big Show faces The Corre's Wade Barrett. Plus, Kofi Kingston, Jack Swagger, and more in action.

videos.title: SmackDown - Mar. 04, 2011
videos.overview: Alberto Del Rio and World Heavyweight Champion Edge sign the contract for their upcoming battle at WrestleMania XXVII. The Undertaker addresses the recent comments made by Triple H. Two giants collide when Kane goes one-on-one with Big Show. Plus, the rivalry between Rey Mysterio and Cody Rhodes continues, Jack Swagger faces JTG, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Mar. 11, 2011
videos.overview: Christian teams with World Heavyweight Champion Edge to take on Alberto Del Rio & Brodus Clay. For the first time in over a year, Triple H returns to SmackDown to send a message to his WrestleMania opponent The Undertaker. After addressing his issues with WWE Champion The Miz, John Cena finds himself at odds with Jack Swagger. All this and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Mar. 18, 2011
videos.overview: An altercation between Christian and Alberto Del Rio leads SmackDown General Manager Theodore Long to order both men to compete in a Steel Cage Match. Big Show and Kane put aside their differences in an effort to bring down The Corre when they challenge Heath Slater and Justin Gabriel for the WWE Tag Team Championships. Plus, Rey Mysterio and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Mar. 25, 2011
videos.overview: As the Road to WrestleMania XXVII continues, The Undertaker delivers a final word of warning to his upcoming opponent, Triple H. After SmackDown General Manager Theodore Long forbids any contact between Alberto Del Rio and World Heavyweight Champion Edge, The Mexican Aristocrat battles Christian. Plus, Wade Barrett, CM Punk, Rey Mysterio, and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Apr. 01, 2011
videos.overview: With WrestleMania XXVII just a few days away, this edition of SmackDown features a look at all the action and excitement heading into the upcoming battles on The Grandest Stage of Them All. Plus, a look at all the happenings at Axxess, interviews with various Superstars, and much more, including a match for the Intercontinental Championship.

videos.title: SmackDown - Apr. 08, 2011
videos.overview: Alberto Del Rio faces Christian for a World Heavyweight Championship Match at Extreme Rules. Big Show partners with Kane, Santino Marella, and Kof Kingston to take on The Corre in a 2-Out-of-3 Falls Eight-Man Tag Team Match. Plus, Kelly and Beth Phoenix team up, Sin Cara makes his arrival on SmackDown to confront Jack Swagger, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Apr. 15, 2011
videos.overview: Edge's untimely retirement forces him to relinquish the World Heavyweight Championship. A 20-Man Battle Royal is held to determine who will face Alberto Del Rio for the vacated title in a Ladder Match at Extreme Rules. Rey Mysterio battles Drew McIntyre. Plus, The Corre's Ezekiel Jackson takes on Kofi Kingston, Layla battles Kelly Kelly, and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Apr. 22, 2011
videos.overview: While the WWE Universe mourns the end of Edge's in-ring career, Alberto Del Rio preys on their emotions by throwing an unceremonious Retirement Party for The Rated-R Superstar. Heath Slater & Justin Gabriel defend the WWE Tag Team Championship against Kane & Big Show. Wade Barrett defends the Intercontinental Championship against Kofi Kingston.

videos.title: SmackDown - Apr. 29, 2011
videos.overview: Randy Orton & Christian take on Alberto Del Rio & Brodus Clay. Before heading to Raw, Rey Mysterio competes against Mark Henry in his final match with the brand. Heath Slater & Justin Gabriel look to bring the WWE Tag Team Championship back to The Corre when they challenge Big Show & Kane for the gold. All this and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - May. 06, 2011
videos.overview: The WWE Universe decides whether Mark Henry, The Great Khali, or Randy Orton will challenge Christian for the World Heavyweight Championship in the main event. Daniel Bryan battles Sheamus. Kharma makes her presence felt when Layla takes on Alicia Fox. Plus, Ezekiel Jackson makes a business decision, Sin Cara battles Tyson Kidd, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - May. 13, 2011
videos.overview: Christian & World Heavyweight Champion Randy Orton take on Sheamus & Mark Henry. Intercontinental Champion Wade Barrett battles Kane. Two former members of Legacy clash when Ted DiBiase faces Cody Rhodes. Plus, Kharma targets Layla once again, Sin Cara goes one-on-one with Daniel Bryan, and much more action.

videos.title: SmackDown - May. 20, 2011
videos.overview: World Heavyweight Champion Randy Orton faces Mark Henry. After sending his former allies in The Corre a message, Ezekiel Jackson finds himself aligning with WWE Tag Team Champions Kane and Big Show for a Six-Man Tag Team Match against Heath Slater, Justin Gabriel, and Intercontinental Champion Wade Barrett. Plus, Daniel Bryan and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - May. 27, 2011
videos.overview: Christian, Mark Henry, and Sheamus meet in a Triple Threat Match to determine the new No. 1 Contender for the World Heavyweight Championship. Ezekiel Jackson continues his crusade against The Corre by taking on Heath Slater. Plus, Kane battles The Great Khali in a Monster Brawl, Daniel Bryan goes one-on-one with Cody Rhodes, and much more action.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jun. 03, 2011
videos.overview: Sheamus challenges Randy Orton for the World Heavyweight Championship. Wade Barrett defends the Intercontinental Championship against his former ally Ezekiel Jackson. Jinder Mahal makes his in-ring debut by going one-on-one with Yoshi Tatsu. Plus, Daniel Bryan in action, Christian takes on Mark Henry, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jun. 10, 2011
videos.overview: Christian turns his back on the WWE Universe and asks World Heavyweight Champion Randy Orton for one more golden opportunity. After responding to this request, The Viper takes to the ring to go one-on-one with Sheamus in a No Disqualification Match. Plus, The Corre in a Six-Man Tag Team Match and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jun. 17, 2011
videos.overview: In the hopes of being added to the upcoming battle for the World Heavyweight Championship at Capitol Punishment, Sheamus goes one-on-one with Christian in the main event. Alberto Del Rio vows to get even with Big Show. Following the dissolution of The Corre, Heath Slater & Justin Gabriel take on The Usos.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jun. 24, 2011
videos.overview: After SmackDown General Manager Theodore Long refuses to change the outcome of Capitol Punishment, Christian finds himself going one-on-one with Kane in the main event. Wade Barrett looks to recapture the Intercontinental Championship when he challenges Ezekiel Jackson for the gold. Daniel Bryan takes to the ring to battle Cody Rhodes.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jul. 01, 2011
videos.overview: Christian demands SmackDown General Manager Theodore Long give him another opportunity to challenge Randy Orton for the World Heavyweight Championship. Ted DiBiase looks humiliate Daniel Bryan when they meet in singles action. Plus, Wade Barrett takes on Kane in the main event, a distraction proves detrimental for Mark Henry, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jul. 08, 2011
videos.overview: After Sheamus clears the ring of all the Superstars set to compete in the upcoming Money in the Bank Ladder Match, SmackDown General Manager Theodore Long orders The Celtic Warrior to go one-on-one with World Heavyweight Champion Randy Orton in a Non-Title Match. Plus, Daniel Bryan, Cody Rhodes, and more in action.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jul. 15, 2011
videos.overview: Days before challenging Randy Orton for the World Heavyweight Championship at Money in the Bank, Christian decides to take a gamble. In preparation for his title defense against Captain Charisma, The Viper faces off with Kane in the main event. Ezekiel Jackson puts the Intercontinental Championship on the line in a match against Ted DiBiase.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jul. 22, 2011
videos.overview: Christian begins his reign as World Heavyweight Champion by facing Intercontinental Champion Ezekiel Jackson. Randy Orton takes on Kane in a Street Fight. Plus, Mark Henry turns up the heat, Daniel Bryan faces Heath Slater, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jul. 29, 2011
videos.overview: With WWE under his control as Chief Operating Officer, Triple H comes to SmackDown to assert his authority. When World Heavyweight Champion Christian tries to play The Game, Captain Charisma finds himself faced with some devastating news. R-Truth's accusations of being the victim of conspiracy lead him to face Randy Orton. All this and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Aug. 05, 2011
videos.overview: Randy Orton & John Morrison take on R-Truth & World Heavyweight Champion Christian. While his rivalry with Mark Henry continues, Sheamus proves that he can stand toe-to-toe with a giant by taking on The Great Khali. Plus, Aksana makes SmackDown General Manager Theodore Long a proposal, Daniel Bryan goes one-on-one with Tyson Kidd, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Aug. 12, 2011
videos.overview: Under the authority of WWE COO Triple H, the Superstars of SmackDown compete in exciting matches. In the main event, Randy Orton goes one-on-one with The Great Khali. Christian faces Sheamus. Ezekiel Jackson defends the Intercontinental Championship against Cody Rhodes. Plus, Daniel Bryan meets Alberto Del Rio, Sin Cara faces Tyson Kidd, and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Aug. 19, 2011
videos.overview: Superstars compete in a 20-Man Battle Royal to determine the No. 1 One Contender for the World Heavyweight Championship. With the WWE Championship now firmly in his grasp, Alberto Del Rio finds himself at odds with Daniel Bryan. Ezekiel Jackson challenges Intercontinental Champion Cody Rhodes. Plus, Justin Gabriel and more in action.

videos.title: SmackDown - Aug. 26, 2011
videos.overview: As Bret Hart fills in as the General Manager of SmackDown, Christian takes legal action to overturn the "Hit Man"s decision on who will receive a chance at the World Heavyweight Championship. Randy Orton battles Ted DiBiase. Sheamus and Mark Henry meet in the main event. Plus, Sin Cara, Daniel Bryan, and more in action.

videos.title: SmackDown - Aug. 30, 2011
videos.overview: Superstars from both SmackDown and Raw compete on a special Super SmackDown Live. When Christian challenges Randy Orton for the World Heavyweight Championship in a Steel Cage Match, Mark Henry shows everyone why he is The World's Strongest Man. CM Punk and Triple H sign the contract for their upcoming battle at Night of Champions.

videos.title: SmackDown - Sep. 09, 2011
videos.overview: Despite being forbidden to have any physical contact with World Heavyweight Champion Randy Orton, Mark Henry looks to make his presence felt in a big way when The Viper goes one-on-one with Intercontinental Champion Cody Rhodes. Sheamus takes on Wade Barrett. WWE Tag Team Champions Air Boom battle Jinder Mahal and The Great Khali and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Sep. 16, 2011
videos.overview: Edge welcomes Mark Henry and World Heavyweight Champion Randy Orton to The Cutting Edge. While his suspicious actions continue to baffle the WWE Universe, Sin Cara takes to the ring to go one-on-one with Daniel Bryan. Wade Barrett & Christian unite to take on Justin Gabriel & Sheamus in a tag team match. All this and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Sep. 23, 2011
videos.overview: Christian challenges Mark Henry for the World Heavyweight Championship in a Lumberjack Match. Another confrontation between Sin Cara and Daniel Bryan leaves the WWE Universe seeing double. Randy Orton takes on Intercontinental Champion Cody Rhodes in a Non-Title Match. Plus, Wade Barrett, Air Boom, and many more in action.

videos.title: SmackDown - Sep. 30, 2011
videos.overview: Randy Orton faces Christian in the main event. Sheamus looks to add another accolade to his list of accomplishments when The Celtic Warrior challenges Cody Rhodes for the Intercontinental Championship. Plus, Sin Cara's identity is threatened by another masked Superstar, Natalya takes on Divas Champion Kelly Kelly, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Oct. 07, 2011
videos.overview: In the main event, Sheamus & Randy Orton team up to take on Christian & Intercontinental Champion Cody Rhodes. Tensions between two of WWE's biggest Superstars explode when Big Show vows revenge on World Heavyweight Champion Mark Henry. All this and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Oct. 14, 2011
videos.overview: For an opportunity to challenge any champion of their own choosing in the main event, several Superstars compete in the largest Battle Royal in WWE history. Divas Champion Beth Phoenix faces Kelly Kelly. Plus, WWE Champion Alberto Del Rio in action, the battle of the Sin Caras continues, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Oct. 21, 2011
videos.overview: WWE Champion Alberto Del Rio reluctantly competes in the main event against Big Show. The battle of the Sin Caras is set to come to an end when they meet in a Mask vs. Mask Match. Randy Orton's problems with Intercontinental Champion Cody Rhodes escalate. World Heavyweight Champion Mark Henry battles John Morrison. Plus, Daniel Bryan and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Oct. 28, 2011
videos.overview: CM Punk challenges Christian to a match. Following his loss to World Heavyweight Champion Mark Henry, Big Show addresses his rivalry with The World's Strongest Man. Awesome Truth battles WWE Tag Team Champions Air Boom. Plus, Wade Barrett in action, United States Champion Dolph Ziggler faces Randy Orton, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Nov. 04, 2011
videos.overview: World Heavyweight Champion Mark Henry faces Daniel Bryan. Randy Orton and Intercontinental Champion Cody Rhodes clash in a Non-Title Street Fight. When Christian is assaulted backstage, Wade Barrett steps up to take his place in a match against Sheamus. Plus, Tyson Kidd in action, Epico makes his in-ring debut against Sin Cara, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Nov. 11, 2011
videos.overview: With both men looking to lead Team SmackDown into Survivor Series, Randy Orton and Wade Barrett meet one-on-one in the main event. Daniel Bryan battles World Heavyweight Champion Mark Henry. Sheamus clashes with Christian in singles action. Plus, Hunico & Primo face off against The Usos, Jinder Mahal faces Ted DiBiase, and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Nov. 18, 2011
videos.overview: World Heavyweight Champion Mark Henry makes an example out of Daniel Bryan to send a message to Big Show. Randy Orton & Sheamus battle Wade Barrett & Intercontinental Champion Cody Rhodes. Plus, Christian, Sin Cara, Kofi Kingston, and many more in action.

videos.title: SmackDown - Nov. 25, 2011
videos.overview: After his attempt to take advantage of an injured Mark Henry backfires, Daniel Bryan finds himself competing against Wade Barrett, Randy Orton, and Intercontinental Champion Cody Rhodes in a Fatal 4-Way Match main event to determine who will receive an opportunity for the World Heavyweight Championship. All this and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Dec. 02, 2011
videos.overview: Christmas may come a little early for Daniel Bryan when he challenges Mark Henry for the World Heavyweight Championship in a Steel Cage Match. Randy Orton gets into the spirit of the holidays by taking on David Otunga in a Miracle on 34th Street Fight. Plus, a Mistletoe on a Pole Match, an All I Want for Christmas Battle Royal, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Dec. 09, 2011
videos.overview: Wade Barrett and Randy Orton compete in a pair of Beat the Clock Challenges for the opportunity to choose the stipulation for their upcoming match. A cheap shot from World Heavyweight Champion Mark Henry sends Big Show into a rampage. Plus, Daniel Bryan in action, Sheamus goes one-on-one with David Otunga, Cody Rhodes joins commentary, and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Dec. 16, 2011
videos.overview: Big Show takes on Jack Swagger in singles competition. Randy Orton partners with Zack Ryder to face Wade Barrett & United States Champion Dolph Ziggler. Amidst his ongoing rivalry with Booker T, Intercontinental Champion Cody Rhodes takes to the ring to go one-on-one with Daniel Bryan. Plus, Sheamus, Natalya, and many more in action.

videos.title: SmackDown - Dec. 23, 2011
videos.overview: When things break down in a main event confrontation between Dolph Ziggler and World Heavyweight Champion Daniel Bryan, SmackDown General Manager Theodore Long takes matters into his own hands. Randy Orton targets Wade Barrett. Plus, Intercontinental Champion Cody Rhodes and United States Champion Zack Ryder meet in singles action and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Dec. 30, 2011
videos.overview: Randy Orton and Wade Barrett meet in a Falls Count Anywhere Match. Despite being scheduled to partner with World Heavyweight Champion Daniel Bryan against Mark Henry & David Otunga, Big Show finds himself competing in singles action. Plus, Booker T's problems with Cody Rhodes continue, Sheamus goes one-on-one with Heath Slater, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jan. 06, 2012
videos.overview: SmackDown kicks off 2012 with two huge championship matches - Daniel Bryan defends the World Heavyweight Championship against the 'World's Largest Athlete', The Big Show, and Cody Rhodes and Booker T battle for the Intercontinental Championship.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jan. 13, 2012
videos.overview: Daniel Bryan must defend the World Heavyweight Championship in a no-count-out, no-disqualification rematch against Big Show. Sheamus looks for revenge when he faces Jinder Mahal.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jan. 20, 2012
videos.overview: SmackDown comes to Las Vegas for a special Sin City SmackDown featuring Daniel Bryan defending the World Heavyweight Championship against the 'World's Strongest Athlete', Mark Henry, and Sheamus and Wade Barrett battling one-on-one.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jan. 27, 2012
videos.overview: Just days before the 25th Anniversary of the Royal Rumble, Randy Orton returns to face the man that put him out of commission, Wade Barrett. World Heavyweight Champion Daniel Bryan confronts Big Show about what the 'World's Largest Athlete' did to Bryan's girlfriend AJ.

videos.title: SmackDown - Feb. 03, 2012
videos.overview: Randy Orton and Wade Barrett finally meet one-on-one in a brutal No-Disqualification Match, 2012 Royal Rumble Match winner Sheamus makes a triumphant return to SmackDown, and Daniel Bryan learns the identity of his five opponents in the upcoming Elimination Chamber match for the World Heavyweight Championship.

videos.title: SmackDown - Feb. 10, 2012
videos.overview: For the first time ever, World Heavyweight Champion Daniel Bryan faces 'The Viper' Randy Orton. The team of Sheamus and Big Show battle Cody Rhodes and Wade Barrett.

videos.title: SmackDown - Feb. 17, 2012
videos.overview: SmackDown Superstars compete in a battle royal to determine who will take Randy Orton's spot in the upcoming Elimination Chamber Match. Daniel Bryan and Sheamus collide and fellow giants Big Show and The Great Khali are paired together in tag team action.

videos.title: SmackDown - Feb. 24, 2012
videos.overview: Just two days removed from the grueling Elimination Chamber, WWE Champion CM Punk and World Heavyweight Champion Daniel Bryan square off in a Champion vs. Champion Match. Sheamus takes on The Miz and Cody Rhodes gets under the skin of Big Show.

videos.title: SmackDown - Mar. 02, 2012
videos.overview: Randy Orton returns to unleashes his fury on World Heavyweight Champion Daniel Bryan. Teddy Long gives Drew McIntyre one more chance to save his job, but he must defeat the high-flying Justin Gabriel. Plus, 2012 Royal Rumble winner Sheamus is in action taking on Dolph Ziggler.

videos.title: SmackDown - Mar. 09, 2012
videos.overview: Interim Raw General Manager, John Laurinaitis, takes over SmackDown for one night as part of his campaign to oust Teddy Long and seize control of both shows. Fresh off his first United States Championship victory, Santino Marella defends his new title against Jack Swagger inside a Steel Cage. Plus, Randy Orton, Big Show, Cody Rhodes, and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Mar. 16, 2012
videos.overview: Christian returns with a special edition of the Peep Show, which promises to have huge implications for Team Teddy Long's match against Team John Laurinaitis at WrestleMania. Cody Rhodes is out to send a message to his WrestleMania opponent Big Show by taking on the massive Great Khali. Plus, Chris Jericho collides with Sheamus.

videos.title: SmackDown - Mar. 23, 2012
videos.overview: WWE Champion CM Punk pays a visit to SmackDown to join forces with Sheamus in a tag team match against World Heavyweight Champion Daniel Bryan & The Miz. Big Show and Kane square off, with both colossal Superstars looking to gain momentum heading into WrestleMania.

videos.title: SmackDown - Mar. 30, 2012
videos.overview: In the final SmackDown before WrestleMania, Big Show gives notice to Cody Rhodes and promises to finally have his WrestleMania moment. Chris Jericho and Kofi Kingston face off in a thrilling, athletic match. Zack Ryder takes on Drew McIntyre, and an impromptu DX reunion turns sour with the "End of an Era" Hell in a Cell Match looming.

videos.title: SmackDown - Apr. 06, 2012
videos.overview: John Laurinaitis takes his seat as the permanent General Manager, promising to shake the landscape of Friday nights. After his record-setting victory on the Grandest Stage, new World Heavyweight Champion Sheamus gets his first test against the returning Alberto Del Rio, while Daniel Bryan speaks out for the time since his loss at WrestleMania.

videos.title: SmackDown - Apr. 13, 2012
videos.overview: Mick Foley, Jimmy Hart, "Hacksaw" Jim Duggan, Dusty Rhodes and others gather to witness fellow Legend "Mean" Gene Okerlund team with World Heavyweight Champion Sheamus. Plus, "Rowdy" Roddy Piper returns to host Piper's Pit with guest Daniel Bryan, whose reprehensible treatment of now-ex-girlfriend AJ continues to draw the ire of the WWE Universe.

videos.title: SmackDown - Apr. 20, 2012
videos.overview: Daniel Bryan's degradation of ex-girlfriend AJ continues. A determined Randy Orton looks to send a message to Kane. The imposing Big Show takes on the recently-returned Alberto Del Rio. John Laurinaitis continues to undermine his predecessor, Teddy Long. Plus, Sheamus and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Apr. 27, 2012
videos.overview: Sheamus attempts to avenge his loss to Mark Henry on Raw. John Laurinaitis and Eve debut the Teddy Table at ringside, where a reluctant Teddy Long spreads the word of People Power to the WWE Universe. Randy Orton warns that he will unleash hell on the Devil's Favorite Demon, Kane, this Sunday. Plus, Daniel Bryan and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - May. 04, 2012
videos.overview: In the aftermath of a grueling 2 out of 3 Falls Match at Extreme Rules, World Heavyweight Champion Sheamus and Daniel Bryan look to finally settle their score one-on-one. New WWE Tag Team Champions Kofi Kingston and R-Truth take on Hunico and Camacho. In Divas action, Layla faces Natalya.

videos.title: SmackDown - May. 11, 2012
videos.overview: After an unflattering imitation on Raw, The Big Show continues to feel the wrath of John Laurinaitis's 'People Power'. Turmoil ensues as World Heavyweight Champion Sheamus teams with Randy Orton to square off against Alberto Del Rio & Chris Jericho, nine days before their Fatal Four Way Match at Over The Limit.

videos.title: SmackDown - May. 18, 2012
videos.overview: Two days before Over the Limit, an unhinged John Laurinaitis pits the WWE Champion CM Punk in a match against Kane. Number one contender Daniel Bryan looks to gain momentum against Zack Ryder. World Heavyweight Champion Sheamus tangles with one of his Fatal 4-Way challengers, Randy Orton.

videos.title: SmackDown - May. 25, 2012
videos.overview: Empowered Executive Eve sets up a monster Triple Threat Match to determine the next No. 1 Contender for Sheamus' World Heavyweight Championship. Will Kane, Randy Orton, or Alberto Del Rio challenge for the title at No Way Out? Big Show continues to chastise the WWE Universe. Santino Marella settles his announcing squabble with Ricardo Rodriguez.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jun. 01, 2012
videos.overview: CM Punk defends his WWE Championship against Kane. Sheamus faces Dolph Ziggler, while The Prime Time Players are in tag team action against Santino Marella and Zack Ryder.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jun. 08, 2012
videos.overview: Nine days before their World Heavyweight Championship Match at No Way Out, Sheamus and Alberto Del Rio each must contend with some colassal competition in Kane and The Great Khali. And Friday nights are about to get funky as SmackDown snares its very own living, breathing Funkasaurus - Brodus Clay.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jun. 15, 2012
videos.overview: Big Show vents his frustrations with WWE, clearing the air regarding his accidental punch to Mr. McMahon and his disdain for John Cena. Will Cena send a message of his own to the disgruntled giant? Plus, tempers flare between World Champions CM Punk, Sheamus, and a pair of No. 1 Contenders leading to a tag team No Way Out preview.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jun. 22, 2012
videos.overview: Alberto Del Rio faces Christian. AJ is at ringside to witness Kane taking on Daniel Bryan. Dolph Ziggler gets another chance to prove he is worthy of a title opportunity when he faces The 'Great White', Sheamus.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jun. 29, 2012
videos.overview: Christian and Santino Marella team up against Cody Rhodes and David Otunga. AJ Lee goes one-on-one against Layla. Sheamus defends his World Heavyweight Championship against Dolph Ziggler and Alberto Del Rio in a Triple Threat main event.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jul 03, 2012
videos.overview: Fourth of July festivities, Great American Bash-style, with Sgt. Slaughter and "Hacksaw" Jim Duggan.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jul. 13, 2012
videos.overview: World Heavyweight Champion Sheamus and Alberto Del Rio are in action just days before they finally meet one-on-one at Money in the Bank. Can they handle the respective challenges of Chris Jericho and Sin Cara? The Big Show faces The Great Khali, and Christian and Santino Marella square off against Dolph Ziggler and Cody Rhodes.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jul. 20, 2012
videos.overview: After nearly a year away, Rey Mysterio returns to SmackDown in his hometown of San Diego! What will the high-flying Superstar have in store for his nemesis, Alberto Del Rio and the new Mr. Money in the Bank, Dolph Ziggler? And on Christian's Peep Show, guests Daniel Bryan and AJ discuss their wedding plans for the 1000th Raw.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jul. 27, 2012
videos.overview: Coming off the historic Raw 1000th episode, four Superstars vie to become the No.1 contender to Sheamus's World Heavyweight Championship! Can the new Intercontinental Champion, The Miz, hold off the challenge of former champ Christian? Will Ryback's unbeaten streak continue?

videos.title: SmackDown - Aug. 03, 2012
videos.overview: Mr. McMahon reveals the new General Manager of SmackDown, who instantly shakes things up by bookending the night with two huge match-ups. World Heavyweight Champion Sheamus faces Tensai while his SummerSlam opponent Alberto Del Rio meets the recently returned Randy Orton.

videos.title: SmackDown - Aug. 10, 2012
videos.overview: Chris Jericho presents The Highlight Reel with guest Dolph Ziggler. Rey Mysterio takes on the Intercontinental Champion The Miz. With SummerSlam one week away, Alberto Del Rio have waited long enough and will challenge Sheamus for the World Heavyweight Championship in the main event.

videos.title: SmackDown - Aug. 17, 2012
videos.overview: Alberto Del Rio makes his case for Booker T to reinstate his World Heavyweight Championship opportunity. Chris Jericho is looking to build momentum before his showdown with Dolph Ziggler. And who will be Booker T's new assistant, Kaitlyn or Eve?

videos.title: SmackDown - Aug. 24, 2012
videos.overview: Alberto Del Rio and Randy Orton vie to be the No. 1 Contender for Sheamus' World Heavyweight Championship. The Celtic Warrior himself is in action against another Superstar with championship aspirations, "Mr. Money in the Bank" Dolph Ziggler. And Cody Rhodes continues his fixation on the mask of Sin Cara.

videos.title: SmackDown - Aug. 31, 2012
videos.overview: After an RKO cost Dolph Ziggler a chance at cashing in his Money in the Bank Contract last week, 'The Showoff' goes one on one with 'The Viper' Randy Orton. The 'Master of the 619' Rey Mysterio is in action against Cody Rhodes and Sheamus prepares to defend his World Heavyweight Championship at Night of Champions.

videos.title: SmackDown - Sep. 07, 2012
videos.overview: With Night of Champions approaching, will Sheamus' devastating Brogue Kick be banned when he defends his World Heavyweight Title against Alberto Del Rio? Three young and determined tag teams compete to for a chance to unseat the WWE Tag Team Champions. And Wade Barrett has returned seeking to launch a barrage through the SmackDown roster.

videos.title: SmackDown - Sep. 14, 2012
videos.overview: World Heavyweight Champion Sheamus engages in a WrestleMania rematch with Daniel Bryan. Will the Celtic Warrior have the same luck without the use of the banned Brogue Kick? Championship holders The Miz and Antonio Cesaro see action just 48 hours before putting the gold on the line. Plus, Randy Orton faces the dangerous Tensai.

videos.title: SmackDown - Sep. 21, 2012
videos.overview: In the wake of a controversial Night of Champions, WWE Hall of Famer Edge pays the WWE Universe a visit to weigh in on Daniel Bryan and Kane's struggle to forge their bizarre new championship alliance. Plus, World Heavyweight Champion Sheamus teams with Randy Orton to face a pair of hopeful title contenders, Alberto Del Rio and Dolph Ziggler.

videos.title: SmackDown - Sep. 28, 2012
videos.overview: Randy Orton collides with the Big Show, for a chance to become the No. 1 Contender for the World Heavyweight Championship. The SmackDown General Manager Booker T establishes a No. 1 Contender's Tag Team Tournament. Plus, Santino Marella faces Antonio Cesaro in a United States Championship Match and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Oct 05, 2012
videos.overview: Sheamus and Big Show have a heated conversation as they head towards Hell In A Cell. WWE Champion CM Punk is in action and more!

videos.title: SmackDown - Oct. 12, 2012
videos.overview: What will Randy Orton have in store for Alberto Del Rio? Also, weeks before their colossal encounter at Hell in a Cell, World Heavyweight Champion Sheamus and No. 1 Contender Big Show look for the psychological edge by proving which devastating finishing move packs more power: the Brogue Kick or the Weapon of Mass Destruction.

videos.title: SmackDown - Oct. 19, 2012
videos.overview: World Heavyweight Champion Sheamus goes toe-to-toe against the Barrett Barrage in a star-studded Lumberjack Match. Will the Lumberjacks be enough to keep Big Show at bay? After returning to SmackDown last week, 'The Viper', Randy Orton, faces the most must-see Superstar in WWE History, The Miz.

videos.title: SmackDown - Oct. 26, 2012
videos.overview: Just two days away from Hell in a Cell, tensions rise between the World Heavyweight Champion Sheamus and the No. 1 Contender, The Big Show. Team Hell No and Team Rhodes Scholars face each other in separate singles matches before their Tag Team Championship Match at Hell in a Cell. Plus, Randy Orton is in action against Wade Barrett and more!

videos.title: SmackDown - Nov. 02, 2012
videos.overview: In the aftermath of Hell in a Cell, The Miz hosts another controversial installment of MizTV with his guest, the former World Heavyweight Champion, Sheamus. The 'Master of the 619' goes head-to-head with Titus O'Neil, The 'Punjabi Prince' faces off against the Harvard-educated David Otunga, and much more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Nov. 09, 2012
videos.overview: Randy Orton and Alberto Del Rio's rivalry continues to explode as they brawl all over the arena in a Falls Count Anywhere Match. Plus, Big Show & Wade Barrett team up to face Sheamus & William Regal, The Miz challenges Kofi Kingston for the Intercontinental Championship, and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Nov. 16, 2012
videos.overview: With Survivor Series just 48 hours away, the eclectic members of Team Foley and Team Ziggler attempt to get on the same page. Sheamus is bent on getting his hands on Big Show before their scheduled rematch for the World Heavyweight Championship on Sunday. Meanwhile, Big Show faces another colossal confrontation in the ring from a mystery opponent.

videos.title: SmackDown - Nov. 23, 2012
videos.overview: It's the night after Thanksgiving, but the Superstars of SmackDown are still hungry for a feast. Randy Orton, faces off against Dolph Ziggler. World Heavyweight Champion Big Show has his giant hands full in a Handicap Match against Team Hell No. And John Cena addresses the WWE Universe for the first time since his shocking kiss with AJ Lee on Raw.

videos.title: SmackDown - Nov. 30, 2012
videos.overview: Sheamus faces Dolph Ziggler, but with an angry Big Show in the building and John Cena returning to SmackDown for the second week in a row, will all these combustible elements explode? Also in action, the Intercontinental Champion Kofi Kingston & Tag Team Champions Team Hell No take on Wade Barrett & The Prime Time Players.

videos.title: SmackDown - Dec. 07, 2012
videos.overview: The Shield and Team Hell No attempt to gain an edge heading into their Six-Man Tables, Ladders & Chairs Match at WWE TLC. Big Show and Sheamus are in action, but can the rivals last nine days without brutalizing each other before their Chairs Match for the World Heavyweight Championship? Plus, Randy Orton takes on Wade Barrett.

videos.title: SmackDown - Dec. 14, 2012
videos.overview: Just 48 hours before facing Sheamus in a Chairs Match at WWE Tables, Ladders & Chairs, what manipulative tactics will Big Show use to keep his World Heavyweight Championship? Who will be The Shield's next victim as they build momentum toward their clash with Ryback and Team Hell No? Plus, Kofi Kingston, Alberto Del Rio, Antonio Cesaro, and more.

videos.title: SmackDown - Dec. 18, 2012
videos.overview: AJ Lee addresses her shocking actions at WWE TLC, as well as her association with Dolph Ziggler and massive newcomer Big E Langston. Ryback issues a challenge to WWE Champion CM Punk for the start of 2013, and John Cena and Sheamus team up for a tag team main event vs Ziggler and World Heavyweight Champion Big Show.

videos.title: SmackDown - Dec. 28, 2012
videos.overview: In the final SmackDown of 2012, Big Show defends his World Heavyweight Championship, but who will be the challenger after a bizarre turn of events? Dolph Ziggler takes on The Miz with AJ Lee and Big E Langston by his side. Brad Maddox has one more chance to earn an elusive WWE contract, but he must defeat The Celtic Warrior Sheamus.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jan. 04, 2013
videos.overview: SmackDown rings in the new year with the return of Randy Orton! And with the upcoming Royal Rumble on his mind, The 'Viper' teams with Sheamus against two reigning champions, Big Show and Antonio Cesaro. Plus, Kofi Kingston gets a chance for a rematch againt the man who took his Intercontinental Championship, Wade Barrett.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jan. 11, 2013
videos.overview: FINALLY...The Rock comes back to SmackDown for the first time in 10 years! What will 'The People's Champ' have to say in response to CM Punk's comments? Plus, General Manager Booker T kicks off the new year with a major bombshell affecting the main event match between World Heavyweight Champion Big Show and Albert Del Rio.

videos.title: SmackDown - Jan. 18, 2013
videos.overview: It's the 700th episode of SmackDown! Alberto Del Rio kicks off his new championship reign with a fiesta of grand proportions. But when rivals crash the party, the turmoil leads to a massive Tag Team main event.
