videos.title: January 1, 2021
videos.overview: Kevin Owens seeks to finish Jey Uso once and for all. Intercontinental Champion Big E & Apollo Crews face Sami Zayn & King Corbin. The Street Profits celebrate the new year. The Riott Squad take on Natalya & Tamina. SmackDown Women's Champion Sasha Banks teams with Bianca Belair to face Bayley & Carmella.

videos.title: January 8, 2021
videos.overview: A Gauntlet Match determines who will challenge Universal Champion Roman Reigns at Royal Rumble. Big E defends the Intercontinental Title against Apollo Crews. The Street Profits face Dolph Ziggler & Robert Roode for the SmackDown Tag Team Championship.

videos.title: January 15, 2021
videos.overview: WWE Official Adam Pearce outmaneuvers Roman Reigns and Paul Heyman. Bayley hosts the first edition of her new talk show, "Ding Dong, Hello!" with special guest Bianca Belair. Shinsuke Nakamura seeks payback on Jey Uso. Daniel Bryan battles Cesaro. Apollo Crews goes one-on-one with Sami Zayn.

videos.title: January 22, 2021
videos.overview: Paul Heyman manipulates WWE Official Adam Pearce into a match. Bianca Belair accepts Bayley's Ultimate Athlete Obstacle Course Challenge. SmackDown Women's Champion Sasha Banks battles Carmella's sommelier, Reginald. WWE Women's Tag Team Champions Asuka & Charlotte Flair face The Riott Squad in a non-title match. Cesaro takes on Dolph Ziggler.

videos.title: January 29, 2021
videos.overview: Universal Champion Roman Reigns and Kevin Owens escalate their very personal war of words. Daniel Bryan faces AJ Styles. Bianca Belair takes on Bayley. Dominik Mysterio goes one-on-one with King Corbin.

videos.title: February 5, 2021
videos.overview: Royal Rumble Match winner Edge confronts Universal Champion Roman Reigns. Bianca Belair celebrates her Royal Rumble Match victory. Ruby Riott faces Bayley. Daniel Bryan goes one-on-one with Cesaro. Dominik Mysterio battles King Corbin.

videos.title: February 12, 2021
videos.overview: Several Superstars compete in Elimination Chamber Qualification Matches. SmackDown Women's Champion Sasha Banks & Bianca Belair confront WWE Women's Tag Team Champions Nia Jax & Shayna Baszler. Seth Rollins returns with a message for Cesaro.

videos.title: February 19, 2021
videos.overview: The six Superstars competing in the Elimination Chamber battle in a high-stakes, Six-Man Tag Team Match. Seth Rollins makes a statement. The Mysterios take on Otis & Chad Gable. Bayley's "Ding Dong, Hello!" results in a Six-Person Tag Team Match. Shinsuke Nakamura faces Apollo Crews.

videos.title: February 26, 2021
videos.overview: Daniel Bryan has a challenge for Universal Champion Roman Reigns. Royal Rumble Match winner Bianca Belair reveals her WrestleMania choice. Seth Rollins invites Cesaro to “embrace the vision." Apollo Crews reintroduces himself to the WWE Universe. Rey Mysterio & Dominik Mysterio face Otis & Chad Gable. Tamina goes one-on-one with Liv Morgan.

videos.title: March 5, 2021
videos.overview: Daniel Bryan battles Jey Uso in a Steel Cage Match with a Universal Championship opportunity on the line. Apollo Crews issues a challenge to Intercontinental Champion Big E. Cesaro faces Murphy. Bianca Belair goes one-on-one with Shayna Baszler. The Street Profits each compete in singles action.

videos.title: March 12, 2021
videos.overview: Universal Champion Roman Reigns and Daniel Bryan sign their Title Match Contract for Fastlane. Big E issues an Open Challenge for his Intercontinental Championship. SmackDown Women's Champion Sasha Banks & Bianca Belair face Natalya & Tamina. Cesaro takes on Murphy.

videos.title: March 19, 2021
videos.overview: Edge competes in his first match on SmackDown in more than a decade, facing Jey Uso to become the Special Enforcer at WWE Fastlane. Intercontinental Champion Big E sits down to talk with Apollo Crews. Shinsuke Nakamura confronts Seth Rollins.

videos.title: March 26, 2021
videos.overview: Daniel Bryan fights his way into the main event of WrestleMania 37. Seth Rollins battles Shinsuke Nakamura and feels Cesaro's wrath. Bianca Belair takes on Natalya. Rey Mysterio goes one-on-one with SmackDown Tag Team Champion Dolph Ziggler.

videos.title: April 2, 2021
videos.overview: Daniel Bryan battles Jey Uso in a Street Fight while Bryan's WrestleMania opponents Edge and Universal Champion Roman Reigns observe. Sami Zayn hosts YouTube sensation Logan Paul for the red-carpet premiere of his documentary. Bianca Belair faces Carmella.

videos.title: April 9, 2021
videos.overview: WrestleMania SmackDown features a pair of colossal matches: The Andre the Giant Memorial Battle Royal and a Fatal 4-Way Match for the SmackDown Tag Team Championship.

videos.title: April 16, 2021
videos.overview: Cesaro rides his WrestleMania victory to a confrontation with Universal Champion Roman Reigns and a match against Jey Uso. New SmackDown Women's Champion Bianca Belair celebrates her title win. The Street Profits challenge Dolph Ziggler & Robert Roode for the SmackDown Tag Team Championship.

videos.title: April 23, 2021
videos.overview: Cesaro issues a challenge to Universal Champion Roman Reigns. Kevin Owens challenges Intercontinental Champion Apollo Crews. Tamina goes one-on-one with Nia Jax. Rey & Dominik Mysterio face Otis & Chad Gable.

videos.title: April 30, 2021
videos.overview: Daniel Bryan puts his SmackDown career on the line as he challenges Roman Reigns for the Universal Title. Apollo Crews defends the Intercontinental Championship against Big E. SmackDown Women's Champion Bianca Belair teams with The Street Profits to face Bayley & SmackDown Tag Team Champions Robert Roode & Dolph Ziggler.

videos.title: May 7, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1133

A special Throwback SmackDown sees Cesaro seek an opportunity at Roman Reigns' Universal Title at WrestleMania Backlash when he faces Seth Rollins. Questions surround Jimmy Uso's return after more than a year out of action. Bayley baits Bianca Belair into a brawl.

videos.title: May 14, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1134

Natalya & Tamina challenge Shayna Baszler & Nia Jax for the WWE Women's Tag Team Championship. Cesaro sends Universal Champion Roman Reigns a message ahead of WrestleMania Backlash. Apollo Crews presents Commander Azeez with a special award.

videos.title: May 21, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1135

Apollo Crews defends the Intercontinental Championship against Big E, Sami Zayn and Kevin Owens. Dominik Mysterio faces Robert Roode. SmackDown Women’s Champion Bianca Belair teams with WWE Women’s Tag Team Champions Natalya & Tamina in a Six-Woman Tag Team Match.

videos.title: May 28, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1136

Rey & Dominik Mysterio defend the SmackDown Tag Team Championship against Dolph Ziggler & Robert Roode. The Usos compete together for the first time in a year against The Street Profits. WWE Women's Tag Team Champions Natalya & Tamina take on The Riott Squad.

videos.title: June 4, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1137

The Usos challenge Rey & Dominik Mysterio for the SmackDown Tag Team Championship. Apollo Crews defends the Intercontinental Championship against Kevin Owens. SmackDown Women's Champion Bianca Belair issues a challenge to Bayley.

videos.title: June 11, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1138

Rey Mysterio seeks retribution on Universal Champion Roman Reigns. Seth Rollins joins Bayley on "Ding Dong, Hello!" Shinsuke Nakamura faces King Corbin. Kevin Owens & Big E battle Sami Zayn & Apollo Crews. Liv Morgan takes on Carmella.

videos.title: June 18, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1139

Universal Champion Roman Reigns and Rey Mysterio collide in a brutal Hell in a Cell Match. Bayley sends a message to SmackDown Women's Champion Bianca Belair. Intercontinental Champion Apollo Crews & Commander Azeez face Big E & Kevin Owens.

videos.title: June 25, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1140

As Jimmy Uso steps up to take his brother's place as "The Right Hand Man," Universal Champion Roman Reigns suffers the wrath of an opportunistic Superstar's return. SmackDown Women's Champion Bianca Belair teams with Cesaro to face Bayley & Seth Rollins.

videos.title: July 2, 2021
videos.overview: Edge sends a message to Universal Champion Roman Reigns. SmackDown Women's Champion Bianca Belair has a challenge for Bayley. Kevin Owens battles Sami Zayn in a Last Man Standing Money in the Bank Qualifying Match. Zelina Vega returns.

videos.title: July 9, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1142

Ahead of WWE Money in the Bank, Edge fends off Universal Champion Roman Reigns & The Usos. NXT Superstars debut against WWE Women's Tag Team Champions Natalya & Tamina. Four Superstars compete in a pair of Money in the Bank Qualifying Matches.

videos.title: July 16, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1143

The WWE Universe returns to witness all the action as The Bloodline face Edge & The Mysterios. Bianca Belair defends the SmackDown Women's Title against Carmella. The SmackDown Superstars competing in the Money in the Bank Ladder Match battle in a Fatal 4-Way.

videos.title: July 23, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1144

John Cena returns to SmackDown with a challenge for Universal Champion Roman Reigns. Toni Storm joins the blue brand. Jimmy Uso faces Dominik Mysterio. SmackDown Women's Champion Bianca Belair defends against Carmella at the Rolling Loud Music Festival.

videos.title: July 30, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1145

The contract signing for Roman Reigns' Universal Championship Match at SummerSlam goes awry. SmackDown Women's Champion Bianca Belair gets help from an unexpected ally. Big E, Cesaro & King Nakamura face Apollo Crews, Dolph Ziggler & Robert Roode.

videos.title: August 6, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1146

Finn Bálor seeks retribution after being robbed of his Universal Title opportunity. After backstabbing SmackDown Women's Champion Bianca Belair, Sasha Banks reignites her rivalry with The EST of WWE. The Street Profits are back in tag team action.

videos.title: August 13, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1147

Universal Champion Roman Reigns and John Cena come face-to-face ahead of their collision at SummerSlam. Sasha Banks ambushes SmackDown Women's Champion Bianca Belair. Seth Rollins offers a warning to Edge.

videos.title: August 20, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1148

Universal Champion Roman Reigns and John Cena come face-to-face before their collision at SummerSlam. Edge issues a brooding warning to Seth Rollins. SmackDown Women's Champion Bianca Belair battles Carmella and Zelina Vega in a pair of matches.

videos.title: August 27, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1149

Finn Bálor and The Street Profits bring chaos to The Bloodline's Family Celebration. New SmackDown Women's Champion Becky Lynch sees several challengers emerge. Happy Corbin has an offer for "Mr. Money in the Bank" Big E.

videos.title: September 3, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1150

Universal Champion Roman Reigns looks to extend his yearlong reign as he faces Finn Bálor. Bianca Belair issues a challenge to Becky Lynch. Happy Corbin and Logan Paul confront Kevin Owens.

videos.title: September 10, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1151

WWE returns home to Madison Square Garden, where Brock Lesnar and "The Demon" Finn Bálor confront Universal Champion Roman Reigns. Edge battles Seth Rollins in a SummerSlam rematch. SmackDown Women's Champion Becky Lynch and Bianca Belair sign their contract for WWE Extreme Rules. Sami Zayn brings a special guest to The Garden.

videos.title: September 17, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1152

Bianca Belair makes a triumphant return to her hometown. New WWE Champion Big E confronts Universal Champion Roman Reigns before teaming with Finn Bálor to battle The Usos. Dominik Mysterio goes one-on-one with Sami Zayn.

videos.title: September 24, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1153

Roman Reigns battles Montez Ford as "The Demon" Finn Bálor lurks in the background. Kevin Owens interrupts Happy Corbin's new talk show "Happy Talk." Zelina Vega faces Liv Morgan. King Nakamura defends the Intercontinental Championship against Apollo Crews.

videos.title: October 1, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1154

The 2021 WWE Draft kicks off. Brock Lesnar sends a message to Universal Champion Roman Reigns and The Usos. Bianca Belair battles Sasha Banks in a WrestleMania rematch.

videos.title: October 8, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1155

Edge looks for payback on Seth Rollins. The 2021 King of the Ring and Queen's Crown Tournaments begin. Roman Reigns demands answers from Paul Heyman. SmackDown Women's Champion Becky Lynch, Bianca Belair and Sasha Banks sign their contract for WWE Crown Jewel.

videos.title: October 15, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1156

Universal Champion Roman Reigns and Brock Lesnar sign their contract for WWE Crown Jewel. The King of the Ring and Queen's Crown Tournaments continue with semifinal matches. Becky Lynch and Sasha Banks collide. The Street Profits challenge The Usos for the SmackDown Tag Team Titles.

videos.title: October 22, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1157

In the aftermath of WWE Crown Jewel, Brock Lesnar looks for payback on Roman Reigns. Controversy surrounds a WWE Women's Title exchange. King Woods celebrates his coronation. Hit Row make their blue brand debut. Shinsuke Nakamura battles Happy Corbin.

videos.title: October 29, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1158

The New Day's King Woods & Knight Kofi Kingston collide with longtime rivals The Usos. SmackDown Women's Champion Charlotte Flair chooses Shotzi as her latest opponent. Naomi is forced to face Shayna Baszler. Happy Corbin & Madcap Moss battle Shinsuke Nakamura & Rick Boogs in a Trick or Street Fight.

videos.title: November 5, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1159

The Bloodline send a devastating message to King Woods & Sir Kofi. Drew McIntyre battles Ricochet. The Viking Raiders make their SmackDown debut against Happy Corbin & Madcap Moss. Sonya Deville asserts her authority in a match between Naomi and Shayna Baszler.

videos.title: November 12, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1160

Universal Champion Roman Reigns battles King Woods in a match to determine the true ruler of SmackDown. SmackDown's Survivor Series teams face upheaval. Toni Storm has a challenge for SmackDown Women's Champion Charlotte Flair.

videos.title: November 19, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1161

The Bloodline attempt to overthrow King Woods. Sasha Banks battles Shotzi. Superstars compete in a Fatal 4-Way Match to capture a spot on the SmackDown Survivor Series Team.

videos.title: November 26, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1162

As rumors surrounding Brock Lesnar swirl around the blue brand, several Superstars compete in a Black Friday Battle Royal to determine Roman Reigns' next challenger. SmackDown Women's Champion Charlotte Flair sends Toni Storm a message.

videos.title: December 3, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1163

Brock Lesnar returns to the blue brand with a plan to ensure he will get an opportunity at Roman Reigns' Universal Championship. Kofi Kingston & King Woods send a message to The Bloodline. Sasha Banks battles Shayna Baszler.

videos.title: December 10, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1164

The New Day, The Usos and RK-Bro vie for the title of WWE's best tag team. Xia Li makes her SmackDown debut. Brock Lesnar sends Sami Zayn a message. Shinsuke Nakamura & Rick Boogs take on Los Lotharios. Drew McIntyre battles Sheamus.

videos.title: December 17, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1165

Roman Reigns confronts Paul Heyman over Brock Lesnar. Drew McIntyre seeks to recover his sword from Happy Corbin & Madcap Moss. The New Day face The Usos. Toni Storm & Sasha Banks battle Charlotte Flair & Shotzi.

videos.title: December 24, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1166

SmackDown Women's Champion Charlotte Flair defends the title against Toni Storm. Drew McIntyre teams with The New Day to battle Madcap Moss & The Usos in a Christmas Eve Street Fight. Superstars vie for an Intercontinental Championship opportunity against Shinsuke Nakamura at Day 1 in a 12 Days of Christmas Gauntlet Match.

videos.title: December 31, 2021
videos.overview:
SmackDown #1167

Michael Cole, Pat McAfee and Becky Lynch count down WWE's top 10 greatest matches and moments from 2021.

videos.title: January 7, 2022
videos.overview: New WWE Champion Brock Lesnar confronts Universal Champion Roman Reigns. The New Day face The Usos in a Street Fight for the SmackDown Tag Team Championship. Royal Rumble Match announcements include several shocking competitors.

videos.title: January 14, 2022
videos.overview: On a highly-explosive SmackDown, Universal Champion Roman Reigns came face-to-face with his former brother-in-arms turned Royal Rumble challenger Seth Rollins, Aliyah broke a WWE record against Natalya, new challengers to the SmackDown Tag Team Title emerged and Lita delivered a Twist of Fate to SmackDown Women’s Champion Charlotte Flair.

videos.title: January 21, 2022
videos.overview: Seth "Freakin" Rollins & Kevin Owens battle The Usos in a match with Royal Rumble implications. The New Day reunite to confront Happy Corbin & Madcap Moss. SmackDown Women's Champion Charlotte Flair faces Naomi.

videos.title: January 28, 2022
videos.overview: Universal Champion Roman Reigns and Seth Rollins come face-to-face ahead of their match at Royal Rumble. Sasha Banks returns. Naomi faces off with Sonya Deville. The New Day tangle with Happy Corbin & Madcap Moss.

videos.title: February 4, 2022
videos.overview: Royal Rumble Match winner Ronda Rousey makes her WrestleMania choice. Goldberg returns with a challenge for Universal Champion Roman Reigns. Intercontinental Champion Shinsuke Nakamura faces Jinder Mahal in a Championship Contender's Match. New Day battle Los Lotharios.

videos.title: February 11, 2022
videos.overview: A week before their Universal Championship showdown at WWE Elimination Chamber, Roman Reigns and Goldberg exchange words of warning. Naomi challenges Charlotte Flair for the SmackDown Women's Championship. Shinsuke Nakamura joins Sami Zayn's "In-Zayn Podcast."

videos.title: February 18, 2022
videos.overview: Shinsuke Nakamura defends the Intercontinental Championship against Sami Zayn. Goldberg and Roman Reigns go face-to-face ahead of their clash at WWE Elimination Chamber.

videos.title: February 25, 2022
videos.overview: WWE Champion Brock Lesnar and Universal Champion Roman Reigns sign their WrestleMania contract. Big E & Kofi Kingston face “The Lethal Lovers” Los Lotharios. Sami Zayn celebrates his Intercontinental Championship victory. Charlotte Flair and Sonya Deville confront Ronda Rousey.

videos.title: March 4, 2022
videos.overview: Ronda Rousey competes on SmackDown for the first time, facing Sonya Deville. Ricochet challenges Sami Zayn for the Intercontinental Title. Pat McAfee learns the identity of his WrestleMania opponent.

videos.title: March 11, 2022
videos.overview: SmackDown Women's Champion Charlotte Flair sends a message to Ronda Rousey ahead of their match at WrestleMania. Brock Lesnar looks for payback on Roman Reigns and Paul Heyman. Ricochet defends the Intercontinental Championship against Sami Zayn.

videos.title: March 18, 2022
videos.overview: Universal Champion Roman Reigns promises to punish WWE Champion Brock Lesnar at WrestleMania. SmackDown Women's Champion Charlotte Flair and Ronda Rousey collide ahead of their match on The Grandest Stage of Them All. Pat McAfee “apologizes” to Austin Theory. Kofi Kingston seeks payback on Ridge Holland.

videos.title: March 25, 2022
videos.overview: Brock Lesnar destroys Roman Reigns' locker room. Ricochet battles "The Lethal Lovers" Los Lotharios. Charlotte Flair and Ronda Rousey have words ahead of WrestleMania. King Woods looks to make Ridge Holland pay.

videos.title: April 1, 2022
videos.overview: On the eve of the most stupendous WrestleMania in history, more than 20 Superstars compete in the Andre the Giant Battle Royal. Ricochet defends the Intercontinental Championship against Angel and Humberto. Drew McIntyre crashes "Happy Talk." Charlotte Flair and Ronda Rousey have words ahead of their SmackDown Women's Title Match at WrestleMania.

videos.title: April 8, 2022
videos.overview: In the first SmackDown after WrestleMania, Undisputed WWE Universal Champion Roman Reigns reveals what's next for him on The Island of Relevancy. Ronda Rousey addresses her loss to Charlotte Flair at The Show of Shows. Happy Corbin hosts "Happy Talk" with his cohort Madcap Moss.

videos.title: April 15, 2022
videos.overview: Raw Tag Team Champions RK-Bro confront SmackDown Tag Team Champions The Usos. SmackDown Women's Champion Charlotte Flair makes Drew Gulak say "I quit!" Ricochet defends the Intercontinental Title against Jinder Mahal.

videos.title: April 22, 2022
videos.overview: Chaos ensues as Ronda Rousey and Charlotte Flair sign their contract for WrestleMania Backlash. Xavier Woods battles Butch. Sami Zayn and Drew McIntyre square off in a Lumberjack Match.

videos.title: April 29, 2022
videos.overview: Ronda Rousey and Charlotte Flair look to make their opponents say "I Quit" in a Beat the Clock Challenge. Drew McIntyre battles Sami Zayn inside a steel cage. RK-Bro and The Usos go face-to-face to sign their match contract for WrestleMania Backlash.

videos.title: May 6, 2022
videos.overview: The Bloodline and “RK-McBro” come to blows ahead of their match at WrestleMania Backlash. The New Day face Sheamus & Ridge Holland in a Tables Match. SmackDown Women's Champion Charlotte Flair battles Aliyah. Madcap Moss brings the laughs to "Happy Talk."

videos.title: May 13, 2022
videos.overview: RK-Bro strike back at The Bloodline. Sasha Banks & Naomi defend the WWE Women's Tag Team Titles against Natalya & Shayna Baszler. SmackDown Women's Champion Ronda Rousey extends an open challenge. Kofi Kingston battles Butch.

videos.title: May 20, 2022
videos.overview: Raw Tag Team Champions RK-Bro battle SmackDown Tag Team Champions The Usos in a Tag Team Title Unification Match. Raquel Rodriguez faces off against Shotzi. Xavier Woods takes on Butch. Shinsuke Nakamura goes one-on-one with Sami Zayn.

videos.title: May 27, 2022
videos.overview: Drew McIntyre joins forces with The New Day to battle The Brawling Brutes. SmackDown Women's Champion Ronda Rousey faces Raquel Rodriguez. Sami Zayn visits "The KO Show." Riddle finds a new tag team partner to challenge The Usos.

videos.title: June 3, 2022
videos.overview: Riddle & Shinsuke Nakamura challenge The Usos for the Undisputed WWE Tag Team Championship. Six Superstars compete for a SmackDown Women's Title opportunity. The New Day & Drew McIntyre battle The Brawling Brutes.

videos.title: June 10, 2022
videos.overview: Riddle battles Sami Zayn with a WWE Undisputed Universal Championship opportunity on the line. Money in the Bank Qualifying Matches begin. Gunther challenges Ricochet for the Intercontinental Title. SmackDown Women's Champion Ronda Rousey faces Shotzi.

videos.title: June 17, 2022
videos.overview: Riddle challenges Roman Reigns for the Undisputed WWE Universal Championship. Madcap Moss looks to get the last laugh on Happy Corbin. Raquel Rodriguez and Shayna Baszler battle in a Money in the Bank Qualifying Match.

videos.title: June 24, 2022
videos.overview: Drew McIntyre & Sheamus fight for their Money in the Bank Ladder Match spots by facing The Usos. Shinsuke Nakamura takes on Sami Zayn, and Shotzi battles Tamina in Money in the Bank Qualifying Matches. Natalya mocks Ronda Rousey.

videos.title: July 1, 2022
videos.overview: A Fatal 4-Way Match determines the final entrant in the Men's Money in the Bank Ladder Match. SmackDown Women's Champion Ronda Rousey and Natalya exchange words. The Street Profits come face-to-face with Undisputed WWE Tag Team Champions The Usos.

videos.title: July 8, 2022
videos.overview: Drew McIntyre seeks a championship opportunity at WWE Clash at the Castle. Ronda Rousey takes on Natalya in a WWE Money in the Bank rematch. The Maximum Male Models serve up their 2022 Tennis Collection. Mr. Money in the Bank Theory teases Roman Reigns.

videos.title: July 15, 2022
videos.overview: Pat McAfee returns to SmackDown. Drew McIntyre looks to get his hands on Sheamus. The New Day mock The Viking Raiders. Adam Pearce names the Special Guest Referee for the Undisputed WWE Tag Team Title Match at SummerSlam.

videos.title: July 22, 2022
videos.overview: Brock Lesnar returns to SmackDown. Ronda Rousey and SmackDown Women’s Champion Liv Morgan come face-to-face. The Street Profits team with Madcap Moss to battle The Usos & Theory.

videos.title: July 29, 2022
videos.overview: Drew McIntyre and Sheamus collide in a Good Old Fashioned Donnybrook Match for the right to challenge the Undisputed WWE Universal Champion. Ronda Rousey & Liv Morgan join forces on the eve of their SmackDown Women’s Championship Match at SummerSlam.

videos.title: August 5, 2022
videos.overview: A shocking return derails a face-to-face encounter between Drew McIntyre and Roman Reigns. Seven women square off in a Gauntlet Match for the opportunity to challenge SmackDown Women’s Champion Liv Morgan at WWE Clash at the Castle. Shinsuke Nakamura looks to earn a future Intercontinental Championship Match.

videos.title: August 12, 2022
videos.overview: Gunther and Shinsuke Nakamura collide over the Intercontinental Championship. The hits keep coming with another shocking return. SmackDown Women’s Champion Liv Morgan and Shayna Baszler sign the contract for their match at WWE Clash at the Castle.

videos.title: August 19, 2022
videos.overview: Ronda Rousey refuses to leave SmackDown. Roman Reigns and Drew McIntyre come to blows. Toxic Attraction make their SmackDown debut as they take on Sonya Deville & Natalya in the WWE Women’s Tag Team Championship Tournament. The Viking Raiders give The New Day a “Viking Funeral.”

videos.title: August 26, 2022
videos.overview: Roman Reigns and Karrion Kross both send messages to Drew McIntyre ahead of WWE Clash at the Castle. The Women’s Tag Team Championship Tournament continues. The New Day respond to The Viking Raiders. Sheamus and Gunther meet eye-to-eye.

videos.title: September 2, 2022
videos.overview: The Bloodline celebrate two years of Roman Reigns as champion ahead of WWE Clash at the Castle. Ronda Rousey calls out Adam Pearce. Karrion Kross makes his SmackDown in-ring debut.

videos.title: September 9, 2022
videos.overview: Drew McIntyre seeks retribution against the debuting Solo Sikoa. Superstars battle in a Fatal 5-Way Elimination Match to earn an opportunity to challenge SmackDown Women’s Champion Liv Morgan. Braun Strowman unleashes on The Alpha Academy.

videos.title: September 16, 2022
videos.overview: Logan Paul announces a Las Vegas press conference and draws the ire of The Bloodline. The New Day, The Brawling Brutes, Hit Row and Imperium collide in a massive Fatal 4-Way Match to determine the top contender to The Usos’ Undisputed WWE Tag Team Titles. Liv Morgan crashes Ronda Rousey’s interview.

videos.title: September 23, 2022
